sections.heading: Black widows love the places you reach into without looking.
sections.body:
Garage corners, irrigation boxes, block wall caps and the underside of patio furniture. We inspect each one by hand, remove webs and egg sacs, and treat the harbourage so the next generation never hatches.

Every visit ends with a written field report: what we found, where we treated, and what to watch for next. If the problem comes back between visits, so do we, free.

items.question: Is the treatment safe for kids and pets?
items.answer: Yes. We use targeted baits and low-toxicity products applied where pests live, not where people and pets do. Most areas are fine to use again as soon as the product is dry, usually within **30 minutes**.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: Most activity drops within a few days. Baits are designed to be carried back to the colony, so you may see a short spike before numbers fall away.

items.question: Do I need to leave the house?
items.answer: No. General pest treatments do not require you to leave. We will ask you to clear under the sinks and keep pets inside while we treat the perimeter.

items.question: What if the pests come back?
items.answer: Then so do we, free. Every plan includes re-treats between scheduled visits at no charge.

items.question: Do you need a contract?
items.answer: No. One-time treatments are available, and protection plans can be cancelled any time.
